source: Full repository grep for ContextAgent and _create_context_agent_class
head: 4f2b83b
summary: ContextAgent is ONLY used in the E38 test harness (tests/e38/test_autonomous_engineering_mission.py). It is registered as the implementation for ALL 7 agent types used in the E38 mission (EXPLORER, ANALYST, PLANNER, DESIGNER, IMPLEMENTER, VERIFIER, REVIEWER). This is a test harness mock that directly writes artifacts without real agent logic. It is NOT used anywhere else in the production codebase.

usages.runtime_path: PRODUCTION - MissionController executes through ExecutionEngine which uses AgentFactory.execute_agent_by_id to dispatch to registered implementations
usages.details: AgentFactory.replace_implementation(agent_type, ContextAgent) called for all 7 agent types. ContextAgent class is dynamically created per-role via _create_context_agent_class(). Each role gets a unique class name (E38ExplorerAgent, E38AnalystAgent, etc.) but all share the same base ContextAgent implementation.
usages.replacement: Replace with operational agents per role type. Need operational agents for: EXPLORER, ANALYST, PLANNER, DESIGNER, REVIEWER (currently missing). IMPLEMENTER and VERIFIER already have OperationalImplementerAgent and OperationalVerifierAgent but they are NOT used for role tasks due to registration order (lines 192-194 come AFTER line 190).

usages.runtime_path: PRODUCTION - Called during test setup for each agent type registration
usages.details: impl_class = self._create_context_agent_class(agent_type, name, description) creates a new class inheriting from ContextAgent with agent_type set. This class is then registered via AgentFactory.replace_implementation().
usages.replacement: Remove this call. Register operational agent classes directly.

usages.runtime_path: PRODUCTION - AgentFactory.replace_implementation() sets the implementation class for the agent type in AgentRegistry._implementations
usages.details: self.engine.agent_registry.replace_implementation(agent_type, impl_class) overwrites any previous implementation for this agent type. This is called for all 7 types, then lines 192-194 overwrite IMPLEMENTER and VERIFIER with operational agents. But by this point, the agent definitions already reference ContextAgent as their implementation_class (line 179).
usages.replacement: Register operational agents FIRST, or remove ContextAgent registration entirely for role types.

usages.runtime_path: PRODUCTION - Attempts to register operational agents for IMPLEMENTER and VERIFIER but too late for role tasks
usages.details: OperationalImplementerAgent and OperationalVerifierAgent registered for AgentType.IMPLEMENTER and AgentType.VERIFIER. However, the E38 mission uses MissionTaskAgent (a different class) for implementation tasks (t5_implementation, t7_testing), and the role tasks (t1-t4, t6, t8-t10) use the ContextAgent registrations. The operational agents are never selected because the agent definitions specify ContextAgent as implementation_class.
usages.replacement: Ensure operational agents are registered and used for ALL role tasks, not just implementation tasks.

usages.runtime_path: PRODUCTION - ContextAgent class definition with execute() method that directly writes artifacts to sandbox
usages.details: ContextAgent(BaseAgent) implements execute() with operations: write_file, run_command, read_artifact. It directly calls sandbox_manager.write_artifact() and creates EvidenceRecords. No real agent logic - just artifact generation. Uses task.context for parameters (path, content, operation, output_path). Has artifact_trace list but it's instance-level and not properly persisted.
usages.replacement: Create operational agent classes for each role type with proper agent logic, lifecycle hooks, and evidence integration.

agent_types_affected.current_implementation: ContextAgent (mock) - but MissionTaskAgent used for t5/t7
agent_types_affected.required_implementation: OperationalImplementerAgent (exists) for role tasks, MissionTaskAgent for implementation tasks

agent_types_affected.current_implementation: AgentType.IMPLEMENTER used via MissionTaskAgent (AgentType.SECURITY not in enum)
agent_types_affected.required_implementation: OperationalSecurityAgent (to be created) or use OperationalImplementerAgent with security context

conclusion: ContextAgent is a test harness mock registered for ALL 7 agent types in the E38 production execution path. No production code uses ContextAgent outside the E38 test. E40 must: (1) Create operational agents for EXPLORER, ANALYST, PLANNER, DESIGNER, REVIEWER, SECURITY; (2) Ensure OperationalImplementerAgent and OperationalVerifierAgent are used for their respective role tasks; (3) Register operational agents instead of ContextAgent in E38 test; (4) Verify all role tasks execute through real operational agents.
